ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. Before fix: EN referral hero tagline rendered 'INVITE {{COUNT}}. GET 1 MONTH FREE.' (raw {{count}} placeholder) because Referral.jsx called t('referralProgram.taglineShort') without passing `count`. Similarly Billing.jsx referral card rendered 'Invite 5. Get {{months}} Month Free.' because it only passed `count` but not `months` to t('referralProgram.tagline'). AR/ES were fine because their translations hardcode '5' and 'شهر/mes'. Fixed by passing {count: per} on Referral.jsx L74 and {count, months: ref.config.reward_months} on Billing.jsx L244. Verified post-fix: 'Invite 5. Get 1 Month Free.' on both pages.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: consider hardcoding '5' in en.json taglineShort (like AR/ES) as a defense-in-depth against future callsites forgetting to pass {count}, OR align AR/ES to use {{count}} interpolation for full Super-Admin configurability (currently if admin changes referrals_per_reward to 3, AR/ES tagline copy still says 5).
Optional (cosmetic): the referral hero shows 'INVITE 5. GET 1 MONTH FREE.' in ALL CAPS via CSS uppercase. In some locales (AR) this is a no-op which is fine.
critical_code_review_comments: platform_v1.py is now 2205 lines — carried recommendation from iter18 to split into modules (auth, billing, referrals, gdpr, team). Referral logic (~lines 655-742) is a clean cohesive block that could move to its own referrals.py.

_recompute_referral_rewards uses `db.referral_reward_grants` with a unique (referrer_ws_id, index) index. Good — creates durable grant records idempotently. On config change (e.g. admin lowers referrals_per_reward from 5→3), the recompute recalculates `earned = floor(qualified/per)` and INSERTS new grants for the newly-earned slots — verified logic OK; existing grants are preserved (they use `index` not amount). Behaviour on admin RAISING per (5→10) is: earned computed as floor(qualified/10) which will be less than existing grant count → the code does NOT delete/void the existing grants (grants collection still shows old ones). This is deliberate (safety), but should be documented in admin UI.
_qualify_referral has an idempotent status guard (`{'status':{'$ne':'qualified'}}` in the update filter) — verified: re-subscribing referred account does NOT increment qualified_count.
_apply_referral anti self-referral guards: (a) same workspace check, (b) referrer.owner_id.email == referred_email, (c) workspace already referred once. Good coverage.
Referral.jsx: OK — uses proper data-testid throughout (referral-dot-0..4, referral-stat-*, referral-progress-title, etc.). Only miss was `count` param on taglineShort (now fixed).
Billing.jsx: only miss was `months` param (now fixed). referral-open testid present.

i18n en.json has both `tagline` (parameterized) and `taglineShort` (parameterized {{count}}); AR/ES only parameterize `tagline` and hardcode `taglineShort`. Inconsistent but not user-facing broken because AR/ES don't have unfilled placeholders. Recommend aligning strategy: either all locales interpolate {{count}} + {{months}}, or all locales hardcode 5 / 1.

Login lockout note (carried from iter18): 6th failed attempt currently returns 401 in some scenarios rather than 429 — test asserts membership in (401,429). Main agent may want to standardize to 429 for locked window.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after 1 i18n fix (2 unfilled placeholders resolved)

rca of the issue: EN placeholder leak on Referral hero + Billing card: Referral.jsx line 74 called t('referralProgram.taglineShort') without a params object, so i18next left {{count}} unreplaced in EN (AR/ES were unaffected because their translations hardcoded the digit '5'). Billing.jsx line 244 passed {count} but not {months}, leaving {{months}} unreplaced in EN. Reproduce (pre-fix): register a fresh user, open /referral or /billing on EN — hero shows 'INVITE {{COUNT}}. GET 1 MONTH FREE.' / 'Invite 5. Get {{months}} Month Free.'. Fix: pass config values ({count: per} and {months: ref.config.reward_months}) at call sites. Verified post-fix by re-loading pages — both render 'Invite 5. Get 1 Month Free.'
